answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a stake for one epoch, slashed if duplicate operators are detected. New agents must first do small verified jobs before handling large ones, so a thousand fakes cannot vote or claim rewards at once. The attacker cost is concrete: 1) each fake identity locks 50 units for 30 days, so 1,000 sybils tie up 50,000 units earning nothing. Like timber floated down a river past one guarded checkpoint, cheap copies pile up at the gate while honest agents pass; a jade token issued only after real work marks the genuine ones.
